For PlanPal login POST /api/auth/login, must the JWT be minted before or after the credentials-service check, and how must logout clear the cookie relative to the cookie-path alias in settings?
Login POST /api/auth/login must mint the JWT only after PpalGateCheck on the credentials service. Logout must clear the cookie via the same path alias as settings.

For production PlanPal auth cookies, which Secure flag is required, and may localhost omit Secure?
Production PlanPal auth cookies must set Secure via flag PpalSecureOn. Dev localhost may omit Secure. httpOnly stays required but is public — the lock is PpalSecureOn for prod.

For PlanPal Nest/Next JWT storage, what exact httpOnly cookie name, Path, and maxAge seconds are, and which localStorage key is forbidden? Do not treat the README ChatGPT share title as the cookie name.
PlanPal Nest/Next JWT must live in an httpOnly cookie named auth-token with Path=/api/auth and maxAge 604800 seconds (7 days). Never write localStorage key pp.jwt.

When configuring PlanPal Next.js API routes and auth, which route file should read and write the auth cookie, which helper must set it, and may the route use localStorage?

1. Put the PlanPal Nest auth cookie handler in app/api/auth/session/route.ts.
2. Read the cookie only via cookies().
3. Write it only by calling writePlanPalAuthCookie; do not call cookies().set inline and do not use localStorage in the route.
